name: SimpleGuardHome
description: A modern web application for checking and adding domains to custom filtering rules in AdGuard Home. Built with FastAPI and modern JavaScript, following the official AdGuard Home OpenAPI specification. Meant as a simple AdGuard Home web interface for users to check if a domain is blocked, and then add it.

paths.name: Rules Backup Path
paths.description: The path where SimpleGuardHome will backup rules.

ports.name: SimpleGuardHome WebUI Port
ports.description: Port that SimpleGuardHome will be accessed at.

variables.name: Adguard Home URL
variables.description: The full URL of your hosted Adguard Home instance, with the protocol (http or https) prepended without port.

variables.name: Adguard Home Port
variables.description: The port used to connect to your Adguard Home instance.

variables.name: Adguard Home Username
variables.description: The username for the Adguard Home user.

variables.name: Adguard Home Password
variables.description: The password for the Adguard Home user.
